_comment: The screen Qt's offscreen platform plugin presents to a test process.
test entry points set on macOS; scada_qt_import_offscreen_platform_into_tests()
in ScadaProductBase.cmake hands them the path as a compile definition.
Without a config file the plugin's built-in screen is 800x600, and
QWidget::restoreGeometry() clamps a restored window to the screen, so a
test that saves a 1000-wide window and expects it back got 798.
A desktop-sized screen at 1x keeps that class of assertion true.
The keys are the plugin's own (QOffscreenIntegration::defaultConfiguration),
verified against this tree's Qt on 2026-09-07.
